Cloud file storage, upload, backup, and file management tool for Tencent Agent Storage (专属网盘).
Manages the user's personal cloud drive: upload files, list files, download, share links, preview, and backup.
MUST trigger when the user mentions ANY of the following concepts:
【云盘/网盘相关 — Cloud Drive Access】
- "网盘", "云盘", "云空间", "龙虾盘", "龙虾云盘", "龙虾网盘", "龙虾空间"
- "专属云盘", "专属网盘", "专属空间", "我的云盘", "我的网盘", "我的龙虾"
- "打开网盘", "打开云盘", "进入网盘", "进入云盘", "看看云盘", "看看网盘"
- "cloud drive", "my drive", "open drive", "lobster drive"
【文件列表/查看 — File Listing & Browsing】
- "列出文件", "有哪些文件", "看看文件", "文件列表", "我的文件"
- "云盘里有什么", "空间里有啥", "查看云空间", "云空间文件"
- "list files", "show files", "my files", "what files", "browse files"
【上传/备份 — Upload & Backup】
- "上传文件", "上传某个文件", "确定上传", "传到云空间", "上传到云空间"
- "备份到云", "备份文件", "保存到云", "存到网盘", "传到网盘", "存到云盘", "传到云盘"
- "文件传一下", "帮我传个文件", "把这个存一下"
- "upload", "backup", "save to cloud", "back up"
【发送/传输给用户 — Send & Deliver Files】
- "把文件发给我", "整理好发我", "发到手机", "传到手机"
- "做完了发我一份", "弄好了发给我", "完成后把文件给我"
- "导出之后发我", "生成完发给我看看", "跑完了把结果给我"
- "send file", "send to phone", "deliver file", "give me the file"
【链接/分享 — Links & Sharing】
- "生成下载链接", "做成链接", "给我下载链接"
- "生成个链接发给同事", "发到群里", "分享文件", "分享给别人", "发个链接"
- "download link", "share file", "share link", "generate link"
【文件状态查询 — File Status Check】
- "这个云文件还在吗", "之前上传的文件还能下吗", "链接过期了能重新生成吗"
- "is file still there", "can I still download", "regenerate link"
【文件搜索/检索 — File Search】
- "搜索文件", "搜一下", "找文件", "找一下", "查找", "检索文件"
- "搜索云盘", "在云盘里搜", "帮我找个文件", "有没有叫xxx的文件"
- "search files", "find file", "search cloud"
【隐式触发 — Implicit Triggers】
- When a task produces output files (reports, exports, generated content) that need to be delivered to the user
- When the user's intent implies needing a file on another device, even without explicitly saying "upload"
- When MyClaw/agent needs to upload files to generate download links
- Any mention of file transfer, cloud storage, or personal file space in the conversation context

skills.description_zh:
本 Skill 面向中小学教师、教研组长、教学管理者和学校领导，源自罗伯特·马扎诺（Robert J. Marzano）等人开创的《Classroom Instruction That Works》课堂教学研究体系，并依据新版 The New Classroom Instruction That Works 对新一代实证研究的更新与重构开发。
马扎诺及其合作者早期通过研究综合，将有效课堂教学策略转化为教师可以理解和应用的专业实践框架。新版研究在这一基础上重新审视教学证据，把课堂学习组织为六个阶段，并提炼出14项对多样化学生群体具有积极作用的教学策略。 
本 Skill 不只是介绍马扎诺教学策略，而是将相关研究转化为“诊断—匹配—实施—验证”的教学改进工作流。它帮助使用者分析学生在以下六个学习阶段中的具体阻滞：

产生兴趣；
投入学习；
聚焦新知；
理解建构；
练习反思；
迁移应用。

使用者可以输入课堂问题、教案、单元目标、学生作业、测验结果或课堂观察记录。Skill 将根据学习目标、知识类型、学生表现和已有证据，确定主要学习阻滞阶段，并推荐2—4项最适合当前情境的研究支持策略，而不是机械罗列所有方法。

输出内容包括：
学习阻滞阶段诊断；
马扎诺教学研究体系下的策略匹配；
教学策略的适用理由与使用时机；
可直接实施的课堂活动和学生任务；
形成性评价与成功标准；
可观察的学生学习证据；
“如果……那么……”教学调整规则；
面向管理者的低推断课堂观察指标；
集体备课、同伴教练和校本教研建议。

适用于课堂问题诊断、教案优化、单元设计、作业与评价改进、集体备课、课堂观察、教师专业发展和学校教学改进。
本 Skill 延续马扎诺教学研究强调的证据导向和专业判断原则：教学策略不是固定流程，也不是课堂检查清单。教师和学校应根据学生的实际学习需要选择策略，并通过形成性评价和学生学习证据判断策略是否有效。

其核心目标是：
从学生学习在哪里发生中断出发，选择适切的研究支持策略，并通过短周期的实施、观察和反思持续改进教学。

English Description
This skill is designed for K–12 teachers, instructional coaches, department leaders, school administrators, and educational leaders. It is rooted in the Classroom Instruction That Works research tradition established by Robert J. Marzano and his colleagues, and updated through the newer evidence synthesis presented in The New Classroom Instruction That Works.
Marzano and his collaborators helped translate research on effective instruction into a shared and practical professional framework for educators. Building on that foundation, the newer edition reexamines a new generation of empirical studies and organizes effective instruction around six phases of learning and 14 research-supported teaching strategies.
This skill does more than summarize Marzano-related instructional strategies. It turns the research into a structured diagnose–match–implement–verify workflow. It helps educators identify where student learning may be breaking down across six phases:
Becoming interested
Committing to learning
Focusing on new learning
Making sense of learning
Practicing and reflecting
Extending and applying learning

Users can provide a classroom challenge, lesson plan, unit goal, student work sample, assessment result, or classroom observation note. Based on the learning goal, type of knowledge, student performance, and available evidence, the skill identifies the primary learning barrier and recommends two to four relevant strategies instead of presenting a generic list.
The skill generates:
A diagnosis of the primary and secondary learning barriers;
Strategy recommendations informed by the Marzano instructional research tradition;
Explanations of why and when each strategy is appropriate;
Practical classroom actions and student tasks;
Formative assessment ideas and success criteria;
Observable evidence of student learning;
“If–then” instructional adjustment rules;
Low-inference classroom observation indicators;
Recommendations for collaborative planning, peer coaching, and professional learning.
It can be used for classroom diagnosis, lesson-plan review, unit design, formative assessment, collaborative planning, instructional coaching, classroom observation, teacher professional learning, and school improvement.
The skill reflects a central principle of the Marzano research tradition: effective teaching is not a rigid sequence or a checklist. Strategies should be selected according to student learning needs and evaluated through evidence of student understanding, retention, and transfer.

Its central purpose is to help educators:
Identify where learning breaks down, select an appropriate evidence-informed response, and improve teaching through short cycles of implementation, observation, and reflection.
skills.name: hts-six-phase-instructional-diagnostician
